invariants: visitor traffic must not fan out synchronously into PostgREST writes
CMS Data API degradation must not return a 5xx to the public static website
growth events remain durable in Netlify Blobs until DataHub persistence succeeds
a failing backend stops the current drain batch instead of creating retry amplification
scheduler authentication must not depend on PostgREST before authorization
scheduler secret lookup must use the IPv4 Supavisor pooler or an injected Edge secret
CMS circuit-breaker state must use strong-consistency Blobs
public runtime health endpoints must not open database connections
runtime verifier credentials must never appear in query strings
production health must not create database probe traffic

runtime_verifier.reason: Public or bearer-link database probes can leak credentials and amplify outages.

runtime_health.invariant: production health must not create database probe traffic
